heading: Today
text: A stray morning shower in NH. Clouds breaking for sunshine, especially from the Champlain Valley and Rt. 2 south.  A chance of showers late afternoon in Quebec, reaching south to the Adirondacks and Rt. 2 late.  Warm.  Highs in the 60s, from 60 to 70 north to south.  Winds light becoming northwest near 10 mph in the afternoon.

heading: Tonight
text: Becoming cloudy, with showers spreading south through the Adirondacks, and east from I-89 north, and rising chance south late.  Lows in the 40s, a few 30s northeast.  Winds northwest 10 to 15 mph this evening, diminishing to light, becoming southeast up to 10 mph west of the Green Mountains late.

heading: Tuesday
text: Rain and showers likely from the Adirondacks and Rt. 4 north, with showers south, decreasing near and south of the MA border.  Highs in the upper 40s and 50s east and north of I-89, 60s west and south.  Winds south to southeast 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph.
